verdict.rationale: ClickHouse ships an open-source single binary and clickhouse-local that run entirely locally without any account or cloud dependency, explicitly marketed for building/testing/experimenting and fast local/CI file processing via SQL (clickhouse-docs-23, clickhouse-docs-27, clickhouse-docs-15, clickhouse-docs-1). Community corroboration confirms clickhouse-local's local, keyless utility for ad-hoc SQL processing (clickhouse-comm-4). Missing for 10: no explicit CI-pipeline example/tutorial demonstrating offline test usage in evidence.
